next_catalyst.what: Preliminary topline data from the Phase 2 trial of TTI-101 in hepatocellular carcinoma (and from the TTI-109 healthy volunteer study)
next_catalyst.quote: we remain on track to report preliminary topline data in the first half of 2026 from a healthy volunteer study on our next-generation STAT3 inhibitor, TTI-109, and from the Phase 2 trial of TTI-101 in hepatocellular carcinoma
